description: Implementation of the TunerService class for Android TV tuner hardware abstraction, managing demux, frontend, LNB, descrambler, and filter resources, including service instantiation and resource info retrieval.

classes.name: TunerService
classes.description: Main service class managing tuner hardware resources and providing interfaces for clients.

methods.name: TunerService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the tuner service, connecting to the HAL, and setting up resources.

methods.name: ~TunerService
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up the tuner service instance.

methods.name: instantiate
methods.description: Creates and registers the TunerService instance, possibly lazily.

methods.name: openDemux
methods.description: Opens a demux resource by handle or ID.

methods.name: getDemuxInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific demux.

methods.name: getDemuxInfoList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all available demux info.

methods.name: getDemuxCaps
methods.description: Gets demux capabilities.

methods.name: getFrontendIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of available frontends.

methods.name: getFrontendInfo
methods.description: Gets info for a specific frontend.

methods.name: openFrontend
methods.description: Opens a frontend resource by handle.

methods.name: openLnb
methods.description: Opens an LNB resource by handle.

methods.name: openLnbByName
methods.description: Opens an LNB resource by name.

methods.name: openDescrambler
methods.description: Opens a descrambler resource.

methods.name: getTunerHalVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the tuner HAL.

methods.name: openSharedFilter
methods.description: Opens a shared filter with permission checks.

methods.name: isLnaSupported
methods.description: Checks if LNA is supported.

methods.name: setLna
methods.description: Enables or disables LNA.

methods.name: setMaxNumberOfFrontends
methods.description: Sets maximum number of frontends for a given type.

methods.name: getMaxNumberOfFrontends
methods.description: Gets maximum number of frontends for a given type.

methods.name: addFilterToShared
methods.description: Adds a filter to shared filters map and returns its token.

methods.name: removeSharedFilter
methods.description: Removes a shared filter from the map.

methods.name: updateTunerResources
methods.description: Updates internal resource info for frontends, demuxes, and LNBs.

methods.name: getTRMFrontendInfos
methods.description: Retrieves info about all frontends for resource management.

methods.name: getTRMDemuxInfos
methods.description: Retrieves info about all demuxes for resource management.

methods.name: getTRMLnbHandles
methods.description: Retrieves handles for all LNB resources.
